scope: Fingerprint-cache wire semantic validation independent of checksum failure
method: Mutate known v1 little-endian wire offsets and recompute BLAKE3 checksum, so invalid statistics and duplicate keys cannot be rejected merely for checksum mismatch. Also cover every proper prefix of valid408byte cache.
limits: Finite authored cache cases, not every serialization/platform or universal goal proof.
No optimization gain or new production fix claimed; existing validation behavior confirmed.
